sum by (task, title, project) (count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="node_finished"} | json task, title [$__range]))
sum by (task, title, project) (count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="node_finished", level="error"} | json task, title [$__range]))
sum by (task, title, project) (count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="tool_use"} | json task, title [$__range]))

sum by (task, title, project) (count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="task_failed"} | json task, title [$__range]))
sum by (task, title, project) (count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="mr_created"} | json task, title [$__range]))

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="verify_result", level="info"} [$__interval]))

panels.title: Where the time and money go

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (node) (sum_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="node_finished"} | json v="data.costUsd", node="data.node" | unwrap v | __error__="" [$__range])))
topk(10, avg by (node) (avg_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type="node_finished"} | json v="data.durationMs", node="data.node" | unwrap v | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Log volume

targets.expr: sum by (level) (count_over_time({service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type=~"$type", type!="system", level=~"$level"} |~ "(?i)$search" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Events matching the Event type, Level and Search filters above.

panels.title: Activity log

targets.expr: {service_name="ilmari", project=~"$project", type=~"$type", type!="system", level=~"$level"} |~ "(?i)$search" | json task, title, node="data.node", ok="data.ok", cost="data.costUsd", dur="data.durationMs", model="data.model", tool="data.name", input="data.input", text="data.text", reason="data.reason", command="data.command", exitCode="data.exitCode", url="data.url", verdict="data.verdict", findings="data.findings", failureClass="data.failureClass", branch="data.branch", spent="data.spentUsd", ceiling="data.ceilingUsd", attempt="data.attempt"  | line_format `{{ if .project }}[{{ .project }}] {{ end }}{{ trunc 8 .task }}   {{- if eq .type "task_created" }} task started: {{ .title }} {{- else if eq .type "node_started" }} step {{ .node }} started {{- else if eq .type "node_finished" }} step {{ .node }} {{ if eq .ok "true" }}done{{ else }}FAILED{{ if .failureClass }} ({{ .failureClass }}){{ end }}{{ end }}  |  {{ printf "%.2f" (float64 .cost) }} USD  |  {{ div (int .dur) 1000 }}s  |  {{ .model }} {{- else if eq .type "tool_use" }} tool {{ .tool }}  {{ trunc 160 .input }} {{- else if eq .type "agent_text" }} agent: {{ trunc 300 .text }} {{- else if eq .type "task_failed" }} TASK FAILED: {{ .reason }} {{- else if eq .type "verify_result" }} verify "{{ .command }}" {{ if eq .exitCode "0" }}passed{{ else }}FAILED (exit {{ .exitCode }}){{ end }} {{- else if eq .type "review_result" }} review {{ .verdict }}{{ if .findings }}: {{ trunc 200 .findings }}{{ end }} {{- else if eq .type "mr_created" }} merge request opened {{ .url }} {{- else if eq .type "delivered" }} delivered on {{ .branch }} {{- else if eq .type "node_retry" }} retrying step {{ .node }} (attempt {{ .attempt }}) {{- else if eq .type "budget_alert" }} budget alert: {{ .spent }} of {{ .ceiling }} USD {{- else }} {{ .type }}  {{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`

panels.description: Every task event as one readable line, newest first. Filter with Event type, Level and Search above; expand a line for all fields and a link to its task. Scroll down to load older events.
